title: 和柄の区切り線
lead: 麻の葉・青海波・市松などの和柄と、四季の花を使った横長の区切り線12点です。案内状や挨拶文の見出し下に使えます。
subject_en: Horizontal decorative divider lines, each ONE wide thin strip about 6:1 in shape, centred in its cell with space around, made of repeating small motifs along a line. Strips are separate and never touch each other. Traditional Japanese pattern style (washi colours, indigo, vermilion, gold). Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: a divider of repeating asanoha hemp-leaf pattern in indigo
a divider of seigaiha wave pattern in blue and cream
a divider of ichimatsu checks in indigo and cream
a divider of cherry blossom petals along a thin branch
a divider of plum blossoms along a branch
a divider of chrysanthemums with leaves
a divider of red maple leaves
a divider of pine needles and small cones
a divider of hexagonal kikko tortoise-shell pattern
a divider of interlocking shippo circle pattern
a divider of red and white mizuhiki cord knots
a divider of traditional swirling cloud motifs in gold and blue
